title: Pipeline Engineering (Lead Engineer / Senior Engineer / Engineer)
description: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, or a Diploma in Engineering, with relevant engineering, design or 3D modelling experience on Basic / FEED and detail engineering of Indian and international projects. Experience in FPSO topsides engineering is highly desirable.
requirements: 4–8 years of Basic / FEED / detail engineering and installation engineering of pipelines: design and analysis.
Knowledge of Abaqus / Ansys is an added advantage.
Familiarity with pipeline software such as PIPESIM, DNV-ST-F101 tools, DNV StableLines, DNV FatFree, PRCI-AGA, OFFPIPE, CAESAR / AutoPIPE, Technical Toolboxes and Sage Profile.
source: Approved recruitment advertisement, Times of India (Southern editions), 18-11-2026
